source_caption: We’re the Millers (2013) is a comedy about a small-time drug dealer who creates a fake family to smuggle marijuana across the Mexican border. Jason Sudeikis plays David Clark, who recruits a stripper, played by Jennifer Aniston, along with two random teenagers to pose as his wife and kids. As they travel in an RV pretending to be the perfect suburban family, their journey turns into a series of chaotic and hilarious situations that test their fake family bond.

source_details.title: We're the Millers
source_details.synopsis: We're the Millers is a 2013 American comedy road film directed by Rawson Marshall Thurber and starring Jennifer Aniston, Jason Sudeikis, Emma Roberts, Will Poulter, Nick Offerman, Kathryn Hahn, Molly Quinn, and Ed Helms. The film's screenplay was written by Bob Fisher, Steve Faber, Sean Anders, and John Morris, based on a story by Fisher and Faber. The plot follows a small-time pot dealer (Sudeikis) who convinces his neighbors to help him by pretending to be his family in order to smuggle drugs from Mexico into the United States.
